select TRADE_ID TRADE_ID2,SCD_START_DATE SCD_START_DATE_2, SCD_END_DATE SCD_END_DATE_2,* from (
SELECT TRADE_ID TRADE_ID2, * FROM
EDS.TRY_TRADES WHERE TRADE_ID='2289356'
UNION ALL
SELECT TRADE_ID TRADE_ID2, * FROM
EDS.TRY_TRADES WHERE TRADE_ID='2287861'
UNION ALL
SELECT TRADE_ID TRADE_ID2, * FROM
EDS.TRY_TRADES WHERE TRADE_ID='2287954'
UNION ALL
SELECT TRADE_ID TRADE_ID2, * FROM
EDS.TRY_TRADES WHERE TRADE_ID='9999999' ) temp order by TRADE_ID, SCD_START_DATE

D360.STG_EDS_TRY_TRADES WHERE TRADE_ID='2289356'
